name: maws
description: A macOS workstation for supervising Claude Code agent sessions

scripts.build: electron-vite build && pnpm --filter desk-web build && pnpm --filter desk-hub build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --tsBuildInfoFile /dev/null && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --tsBuildInfoFile /dev/null && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json --tsBuildInfoFile /dev/null && pnpm --filter desk-hub typecheck && pnpm --filter desk-web typecheck
scripts.build:app: pnpm build:helper && electron-vite build && if [ -n "$MAWS_SIGN_IDENTITY" ]; then electron-builder --mac dir -c.mac.identity="$MAWS_SIGN_IDENTITY"; else CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir; fi
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:probes && pnpm build && pnpm e2e && pnpm build:app && pnpm verify:fuses && pnpm e2e:packaged && pnpm e2e:supervisor:packaged && pnpm e2e:transcript && pnpm e2e:terminal && pnpm e2e:panel && pnpm e2e:c7 && pnpm e2e:voice && pnpm e2e:code && pnpm e2e:agents && pnpm e2e:widgets && pnpm e2e:settings && pnpm e2e:c12 && pnpm e2e:tools && pnpm e2e:scm && pnpm e2e:side && pnpm e2e:deliverables && pnpm e2e:supervisor && pnpm e2e:browser && pnpm e2e:browser-comment && pnpm e2e:browser-import && pnpm e2e:browser-cua && pnpm e2e:browser-chrome
scripts.e2e:transcript: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/transcript.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:terminal: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/terminal.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:panel: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/panel.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:layout: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && MAWS_HARNESS=0 MAWS_E2E_FOREGROUND=0 playwright test e2e/ux2-shell.spec.ts e2e/shell.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:requests: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/requests.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:composer: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/composer.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:c7: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/requests.spec.ts e2e/composer.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:voice: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/voice.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:code: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/code-tools.spec.ts e2e/code-editor.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:agents: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/agent-tools.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:widgets: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 MAWS_E2E_FOREGROUND=1 playwright test e2e/widgets.spec.ts

scripts.e2e:c12: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && MAWS_C12_E2E=1 playwright test e2e/c12-budget.spec.ts e2e/c12-quit.spec.ts e2e/c12-sweep.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:tools: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/maws-tools.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:deliverables: scripts/e2e-build.sh harness && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/deliverables.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:scm: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && MAWS_SCM_E2E=1 playwright test e2e/scm.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:artifacts-perf: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && MAWS_ARTIFACTS_PERF=1 playwright test e2e/artifacts-store.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:connectors: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && MAWS_CONNECTORS_E2E=1 MAWS_E2E_FINAL_BUNDLE=h-final:plain playwright test e2e/connectors.spec.ts

scripts.e2e:bench-edit-live: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && MAWS_HARNESS=0 playwright test e2e/bench-edit-live.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:presentations-scale: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && MAWS_PRESENTATIONS_SCALE=1 playwright test e2e/presentations-scale.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:design: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && playwright test e2e/design.spec.ts e2e/design-comments.spec.ts e2e/design-history.spec.ts e2e/design-export.spec.ts e2e/design-provisional.spec.ts --forbid-only --add-reporter=./e2e/support/design-final-reporter.ts

scripts.e2e:supervisor: scripts/e2e-build.sh plain && MAWS_SUPERVISOR_E2E=1 MAWS_HOST_MODE=detached MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/supervisor.spec.ts
scripts.verify:fuses: out=$(FORCE_COLOR=0 NO_COLOR=1 electron-fuses read --app dist/mac-arm64/MAWS.app) && echo "$out" && echo "$out" | grep -q '^ *RunAsNode is Enabled$' || { echo 'verify:fuses: dist/mac-arm64/MAWS.app does not report RunAsNode is Enabled; the E10 supervisor runs the app binary as Node (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE)' >&2; exit 1; }
